name: Vortex
description: Windmill blades curling out of every cell, half of them mirrored so the field turns both ways at once.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); --flip: @pick(1, -1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @shape: windmill; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)) scaleX(@var(--flip)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)) scaleX(@var(--flip)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
